basic_info.description: Cosmetic fixer.  Nothing short of a tremendous opportunity exist for whomever becomes the buyer of this Inner Richmond condominium that features 3 bedrooms and 2 baths on 1 level. Absolutely livable in it's current state, chip away at it to modernize over time. This is not a structural rehab, but merely cosmetic.    As a huge plus, a disproportionate amount of the garage is deeded to the unit where there is an additional bathroom, storage room and work area. The rear yard is large, shared, and offers a lot of space for both units to enjoy. Located on one of the most sought after blocks in the Inner Richmond, opportunity knocks loudly; will you answer the door? Shown by appointment and during set open houses only.
